patch.value: GH-675: lifecycle must record actual completion time separately from tracker close time

GitHub issue https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/675 reports that closed_at is always mutation time, causing time-window reports to misattribute late tracker closeout. Add governed actual-completion semantics with migration and query contracts.

patch.value: Items carry a completed_at (actual completion) field distinct from closed_at (tracker mutation time), settable at close and correctable through a governed update; Time-window reports, flow metrics, and changelog bucketing read the actual-completion field when present and fall back to closed_at otherwise, with the fallback disclosed; A lossless migration backfills completed_at for existing closed items from history evidence or leaves it explicitly absent, never guessed; CLI, SDK, and MCP expose the field with typed contracts and the history stream records every correction
